bug_semantics: SiYuan publish mode stores two independent per-notebook/document flags on PublishAccessItem: Visible (listing/navigation) and Disable (forbid publish access). Reader-facing result filters in kernel/model/publish_access.go resolved their ignore list with GetInvisiblePublishAccess (!Visible only) and never consulted GetDisablePublishAccess. A document can be Visible=true and Disable=true at once; anonymous RoleReader callers of search, backlink, asset-content, saved-criteria, recent-docs, graph, and tag endpoints then received that forbidden content. The canonical block-tree check checkBlockTreeAccessableByPublishAccess already used GetDisablePublishAccess. CWE-863.
flaw_origin: PR #16041 (Yuxin Zhao) introduced document-level publish access. Member dfa4e79d831b9dde127e1a187edb8025dbf82941 replaced the single publishignore ID list with PublishAccessItem{Visible, Password, Disable} but built the reader ignore list from !Visible only (GetPublishInvisibleBlocks). Later PR members renamed that helper to GetInvisiblePublishAccess and moved FilterPaths/FilterBlocks/FilterGraph/FilterTags/FilterAssetContent/FilterRecentDocs into kernel/model/publish_access.go still on the invisible list. The squash 3facc37df999583fac6103e2f067a517b8cc0d5e is the first default-branch object containing those Filter* helpers. Later security patches copied the same GetInvisible call into FilterSearchDocsByPublishAccess and FilterCriteriaByPublishAccess.
